dataset_name: Gridwatch Power Grid Cascading Failure Dataset
description: High-fidelity AC power flow contingency dataset capturing immediate post-contingency states (t=0+) and downstream cascade propagation ground truth for Graph Isomorphism Networks.

secondary_targets.name: additional_trips
secondary_targets.description: Number of subsequent branches tripped after initial outage

secondary_targets.name: load_shed_fraction
secondary_targets.description: Fraction of aggregate active load unserved

split_definitions.random: Stratified random split (70% train / 15% val / 15% test) matching overall cascade class balance.
split_definitions.contingency_held_out: Grouped split where unique contingency elements in test and val NEVER appear in train.
split_definitions.operating_point_held_out: Stress-regime split reserving top 20% highest pre-contingency aggregate loads for test.

splits_and_leakage_audit.zero_temporal_leakage_guarantee: Verified: All graph node and edge features are computed strictly from t=0+ (the initial post-contingency AC power flow solution). Subsequent cascade iteration states, intermediate branch trippings, and islanding steps are strictly isolated from model inputs.

feature_dictionary.name: vm_pu
feature_dictionary.description: Bus voltage magnitude computed from the first post-contingency AC power flow solution (nominal 1.0 p.u.).

feature_dictionary.name: va_degree
feature_dictionary.description: Bus voltage phase angle relative to the system reference / slack bus.

feature_dictionary.name: p_load_mw
feature_dictionary.description: Active power demand demanded at the bus under current operating point load scaling.

feature_dictionary.name: q_load_mvar
feature_dictionary.description: Reactive power demand demanded at the bus.

feature_dictionary.name: p_gen_mw
feature_dictionary.description: Active power scheduled by online generation units attached to the bus.

feature_dictionary.name: q_gen_mvar
feature_dictionary.description: Reactive power dispatched by online generators.

feature_dictionary.name: delta_vm
feature_dictionary.description: Voltage magnitude deviation from nominal unity voltage (|V| - 1.0 p.u.).

feature_dictionary.name: net_p_mw
feature_dictionary.description: Net active power injection balance (P_gen - P_load).

feature_dictionary.name: net_q_mvar
feature_dictionary.description: Net reactive power injection balance (Q_gen - Q_load).

feature_dictionary.name: is_pq
feature_dictionary.description: Categorical flag indicating a load bus with fixed active and reactive power injections.

feature_dictionary.name: is_pv
feature_dictionary.description: Categorical flag indicating a generator bus with controlled voltage setpoint.

feature_dictionary.name: is_slack
feature_dictionary.description: Categorical flag indicating the reference / angle-slack bus.

feature_dictionary.name: is_outaged_endpoint
feature_dictionary.description: Contingency indicator: 1 if the bus is an immediate terminal of the initially outaged branch or generator.

feature_dictionary.name: p_flow_mw
feature_dictionary.description: Post-contingency active power flow through the branch directed from origin to destination bus.

feature_dictionary.name: q_flow_mvar
feature_dictionary.description: Post-contingency reactive power flow through the branch.

feature_dictionary.name: loading_percent
feature_dictionary.description: Branch thermal loading relative to rated current capacity (I_actual / I_max * 100).

feature_dictionary.name: r_ohm
feature_dictionary.description: Total series resistance of the branch conductor.

feature_dictionary.name: x_ohm
feature_dictionary.description: Total series inductive reactance of the branch conductor.

feature_dictionary.name: rating_ka
feature_dictionary.description: Maximum continuous current rating (thermal limit) of the branch.

feature_dictionary.name: thermal_margin_percent
feature_dictionary.description: Thermal buffer margin remaining before the automated tripping threshold (115% - loading_percent).

feature_dictionary.name: in_service
feature_dictionary.description: Operational status flag: 1 if energized, 0 if outaged by initial disturbance.

feature_dictionary.name: is_outaged_branch
feature_dictionary.description: Contingency trigger flag: 1 if this branch was selected as the initiating N-1 or N-2 event.

citation: Gridwatch: Graph-Based Early Warning System for Cascading Failures in Transmission Grids (2026).
